insight.title: Scientists Are Using Brain Waves to Reconstruct Visual Memories
insight.subtitle: Neural decoders can now translate raw brain activity into the visual images we see in our minds.
insight.notificationHook: Your thoughts are now becoming visible.

sections.text: Researchers have successfully used functional MRI scans to decode brain activity, effectively turning a person’s inner visual perception into reconstructed, recognizable images. The internal "movies" of our minds are no longer hidden.

By mapping how neurons fire in response to visual stimuli, algorithms can now interpret these signals. It acts like a digital translator, converting the complex language of your subconscious into a visual file.

This technology offers a profound bridge between human cognition and external reality. In the future, it could allow us to document dreams, unlock the memories of non-verbal patients, or share complex abstract ideas directly.
The wall between our private thoughts and the world is dissolving.

audioBrief.script:
Welcome to your Sift Daily Briefing. This is the clear, plain version of today's news. Today we look at global stock markets, new trade rules for India, and the American economy, and more.

Global stock markets rose on Thursday according to reports from CNBC. Shares in Europe and Asia recovered from a recent sell-off in technology stocks. Investors watched for news about new taxes on imports called tariffs from the United States. Many stocks had fallen because of worries about high spending on artificial intelligence. On Thursday, the pan-European Stoxx six hundred index rose more than one and a half percent. Germany's DAX index was a top gainer and rose about two percent. In Japan, the Nikkei twenty-two-five index climbed nearly one percent. Large chip companies like SoftBank Group saw their shares rise more than seven percent.

New trade rules from the United States might give India an advantage over other countries in Asia. The United States proposed a seventeen percent tax on goods from India if a trade deal is finished. Without a deal, India could face taxes of up to twenty-five percent. Other countries like China and Vietnam face proposed taxes of twenty percent or more. A partner at a research group says India has a better deal than its main rivals. India's trade surplus with the United States grew to over fifty-seven billion dollars in twenty twenty-five. Narendra Modi and Donald Trump may meet in December at a meeting in Florida. Experts believe the two leaders could sign a trade deal during that visit.

The United States economy grew much faster this summer than the government first estimated. New data shows the economy expanded at an annual rate of four point three percent. This is a large increase over previous guesses for the third quarter. The Bureau of Economic Analysis says the growth happened between July and September.

Sellers of Nvidia chips are seeking new buyers according to three people who spoke with CNBC. The United States has restricted remote access to advanced artificial intelligence systems for Chinese companies. Since the rules were announced on November sixteen, many more chips have appeared for sale. Jack Duhamel of the marketplace GPU Mart says the surge is a result of the new rule. Sellers want to offload chips that were meant for data centers used by Chinese firms. These deals include thousands of advanced chips known as B-three-hundreds. The United States government says the rules close loopholes that let companies bypass export bans. Nvidia declined to comment on the matter.

More than twelve thousand people in the Democratic Republic of Congo have caught the Ebola virus. Government data shows that nearly six thousand people have died in this outbreak. The sickness began in mid-May in a province called Ituri and has spread to eight other regions. This specific type of Ebola has no approved vaccines or medical treatments. Health officials say conflict and weak medical services have helped the virus spread quickly. This is now the second-largest Ebola outbreak ever recorded. The Africa Centres for Disease Control says only fifteen percent of cases come from known contacts. This means many chains of the sickness are still being missed. Satellite images suggest the official death toll may be much higher than reported.

South Korea's central bank raised its main interest rate to three point two-five percent on Thursday. The bank resumed its cycle of raising rates to fight inflation. This is the highest the rate has been since November twenty twenty-four. The bank raised its growth forecast for twenty twenty-six to nearly four percent. The move is a response to high prices and a boom in chip exports. Five members of the policy board voted for the increase. Two members voted no. The bank expects growth of over four percent in twenty twenty-seven. Inflation is expected to stay above the bank's target until the year after next. Analysts expect one more rate hike early in twenty twenty-seven.

Next, we look at how world leaders are meeting in Kenya to talk about the lack of affordable homes.

Governments and housing experts are meeting in Nairobi to talk about the global housing crisis. The meeting takes place at the United Nations on November twenty-six and twenty-seven. Anacláudia Rossbach is the leader of UN-Habitat, the agency hosting the event. She says about three hundred million people worldwide live without a roof over their heads. Another three point four billion people do not have safe or proper housing. This includes more than one billion people living in crowded areas called informal settlements. These homes often lack clean water or safe toilets. The group aims to create new housing rules by twenty twenty-nine. UN-Habitat will launch a new digital tool called the Housing Knowledge Platform.

Next, a federal jury in New York City convicted the Chinese technology company Huawei of ten out of twelve charges. The company was found guilty of bank fraud, wire fraud, and money laundering. Jurors also found that Huawei violated trade rules by doing business with Iran. Huawei is China's biggest technology firm and the world's largest maker of phone network equipment. The jury also convicted three of the company's smaller branch offices. The Department of Justice says the company did not try to hide that it stole trade secrets. Huawei was acquitted of a serious charge called racketeering on November twenty-five. The company plans to appeal the court's decision.

In news from Europe, the number of people moving to Britain has fallen to a very low level. New data shows net migration dropped to seventy-seven thousand people in the year ending in June. This is lower than the two hundred four thousand people who arrived the year before. It is the lowest number since nineteen ninety-seven, not counting the pandemic. The government says the drop happened because of stricter rules for workers and students. Net migration has fallen by ninety percent from its peak in twenty twenty-three. The interior minister says the government has regained control of the immigration system. The government plans to double the wait for permanent residency from five to ten years.

Turning to business, a court ruled that Amazon is responsible for recalling more than four hundred thousand dangerous products. The court decided Amazon is a distributor of goods rather than just a delivery service. This means Amazon must handle recalls for items sold by other companies on its website. The case involved faulty carbon monoxide detectors and hair dryers that could cause electric shocks. It also included children's pajamas that did not meet fire safety rules. Amazon must now notify buyers by email and post alerts on its website. The company must also give full refunds to customers who prove they destroyed the dangerous items. Amazon will be required to keep records of these recalls for five years.

In technology news, a cryptocurrency business owned by Standard Chartered bank suffered a security breach. The unit is called Zodia Custody and it holds digital money for large companies. Chief executive Richard Clark says the breach happened earlier this week. Hackers accessed names and email addresses for some clients and employees. Zodia detected the problem on Monday and took its connection software offline. The company says its investigation shows that no money was stolen. Zodia has since restored its services for clients. Shares in the company rose about two point six percent on the day the news broke. Zodia says it has notified the affected clients and government regulators.

Finally, sixteen people have died after a flood hit a gold mine in Indonesia. The accident happened late Monday in a mountainous area south of the capital city. Heavy rain caused a nearby river to overflow into a mine shaft. The shaft is about one hundred meters deep. Ten other miners are still missing. The mine was being operated illegally, so authorities did not hear about the flood for sixteen hours. Search teams used water pumps on Thursday to remove water from the hole. More than three hundred people are helping with the rescue effort. Police say the chances of finding anyone else alive are now very slim.

Before we go, here is your thought for the day.

Scientists are now using brain waves to see what people are thinking. Researchers use special brain scans to decode activity in the mind. This process turns internal thoughts into recognizable images. It works like a digital translator for your subconscious. The technology maps how neurons fire when a person looks at something. In the future, this could help us document our dreams. It might also help people who cannot speak to share their memories. Our private thoughts are no longer hidden from the world. If you could record your dreams like a movie, would you want to watch them?

That is the news for now, and thank you for joining the Sift Daily Briefing.

audioBriefIndepth.script:
Welcome to your Sift In-Depth Briefing. This is our full analysis of the stories shaping the world today. In this episode, we look at why global stock markets are bouncing back and how new trade taxes might give India an advantage. We also cover a sudden jump in the growth of the United States economy and more.

Why are global stock markets suddenly going up again? Most share prices recovered on Thursday after a big drop in technology stocks earlier in the week.

For the past year, many investors have put a lot of money into artificial intelligence. They hoped this new technology would create huge profits for companies very quickly. Companies like Nvidia, which makes the chips used for this technology, saw their stock prices climb very high. At the same time, the United States Federal Reserve has been trying to lower inflation. Inflation is the rate at which the prices of goods and services increase. The Federal Reserve is the central bank of the United States. It uses interest rates to control how fast prices rise. When interest rates are high, it is more expensive for people and businesses to borrow money. This usually slows down the economy. Investors watch these rates closely because they affect how much companies can grow. Recently, there has also been a lot of talk about new trade rules. Donald Trump often uses tariffs to change how the United States trades with other countries. A tariff is a tax on goods that come from another country. These taxes can make products more expensive for people to buy.

This week, two things happened at once to change the mood of the market. First, investors started to worry that companies were spending too much on artificial intelligence. They were not sure if these companies would get enough money back from those investments. Second, the White House announced a new round of tariffs on many different countries.

On Wednesday, technology stocks on Wall Street fell sharply. The Nasdaq index has a large number of technology stocks. It dropped zero point six two percent. The S&P five hundred index also declined by zero point two five percent. However, by Thursday, markets in Europe and Asia began to bounce back. Germany’s main stock index is called the DAX. It rose about two percent. In Britain, the FTSE one hundred index went up one point four one percent. Investors started looking for bargains after the recent price drops. They bought shares in companies that had lost a lot of value. In Japan, the Nikkei twenty-two-five index rose zero point eight six percent. Chip-making companies like SoftBank Group saw their shares jump more than seven percent. Investors seemed to look past the news about new tariffs for now. But some experts are still worried. Russ Mould is an investment director at the firm AJ Bell. He says higher oil prices could make it harder to control inflation. If oil costs more, it can push up the price of almost everything else. There is also a risk that other countries will hit back with their own tariffs. This could create more uncertainty for global businesses. New data shows that a key inflation measure rose three point eight percent in October. This was the highest rate since May.

This data is important because of the timing of the next central bank meeting. The Federal Reserve meets next month. Officials are largely expected to raise interest rates for the second time this year.

The market recovery happened while United States markets were closed for the Thanksgiving holiday. Trading will resume on Friday, but the session will be shorter than usual.

While global markets look for stability, some countries are finding new ways to compete for trade.

Can a new tax on imports actually help one country beat its neighbors? India might get a better deal on trade taxes than other Asian nations if it signs a new agreement.

India and the United States have been trying to reach a major trade deal for a long time. The United States is India's biggest market for its exports. In twenty twenty-four, India sold forty-five point two billion dollars more to the United States than it bought. By twenty twenty-five, that trade surplus grew to fifty-seven point three billion dollars. A trade surplus happens when a country sells more to a partner than it buys from them. Donald Trump has often complained about these imbalances. He wants other countries to buy more American products. To push for this, he uses tariffs. In February, he announced a deal where India would buy more from the United States. In exchange, the United States would lower taxes on Indian goods. But there have been many delays in finishing the deal. Some of these delays were because of legal issues. In February, the United States Supreme Court struck down some of the president's previous tariffs. This forced the administration to find new legal ways to set these taxes. Negotiators have also struggled with other issues. These include recently passed laws about sanctions on Russian oil. Both sides have found it hard to give up ground in the talks.

On Wednesday, the United States announced a fresh round of proposed tariffs on many trading partners. These new rates show that Washington is willing to give India a better deal than its rivals.

The Office of the United States Trade Representative handles these trade rules. They proposed a seventeen percent tariff on goods from India. But this lower rate only applies if India reaches a new trade agreement. Without a deal, India could face tariffs of up to twenty-five percent. This seventeen percent rate is lower than what other neighbors might pay. For example, China and Vietnam could face tariffs of twenty percent. Bangladesh and Thailand might have to pay eighteen percent. Experts say this gives India a competitive advantage. Atman Trivedi is a partner at a firm that helps businesses with government rules. He says India got a better bargain than its main competitors. This might help the Indian government get support for the deal at home. However, some officials in India are still pushing back. The commerce ministry denied that India has too much manufacturing capacity. This is when a country makes more goods than people want to buy, which can hurt other countries. They said they do not have this problem in any sector. Other countries are also protesting the new taxes. Japan called the plan to tax its products at fifteen percent regrettable. Brazil’s government said it would not yield to threats.

These new numbers were released just before a major meeting. Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Donald Trump are likely to meet in December. They will be at the G-twenty leaders' meeting in Florida.

The new tariffs will not start right away. There will be a period for public comments and hearings before they possibly begin in late January.

Trade deals are one way to measure an economy, but the latest growth numbers show another side of the story.

The United States economy grew much faster this summer than experts first thought. New government data shows that the economy expanded at an annualized rate of four point three percent in the third quarter. This is a significant upgrade from earlier estimates. The Bureau of Economic Analysis released these updated figures on Wednesday.

This growth comes as tech companies face new rules. Next, we look at how sellers of advanced computer chips are searching for new customers.

Why are sellers of advanced computer chips looking for new buyers? They are offloading hardware because the United States government restricted how Chinese firms access them.

Nvidia is a company that makes the world's most powerful computer chips. These chips are necessary for building advanced artificial intelligence systems. The United States government worries that China could use this tech for its military. To stop this, officials created strict export controls. These are rules that prevent American companies from selling high-end tech to certain countries. Nvidia had to stop selling its most advanced chips directly to China. However, the company still earns a lot of money in that market. Last year, Nvidia had nearly twenty billion dollars in sales to China. It can still sell lower-power chips for personal computers without a license. But the most powerful chips are strictly controlled. Some people found ways around these rules. They used data centers in other countries to rent access to the chips remotely. Others smuggled chips through Southeast Asia. Lawmakers in Washington have been watching this closely. They even questioned Nvidia about how its chips ended up in China.

The situation changed on November sixteenth. The United States government announced a new rule to close these loopholes.

This new rule stops Chinese firms from renting advanced chips in overseas data centers. Because of this, an unusually high volume of Nvidia chips has hit the market. Sellers are now trying to find buyers for thousands of advanced B-three-hundred chips. Jack Duhamel is the president of an infrastructure marketplace called GPU Mart. He says the surge in sales is a direct result of the new rule. One seller told him they are selling because of the government's clampdown. Meanwhile, an investigation by CBS News found other ways chips reach China. It found two California companies that are actually controlled by Chinese firms. One of these is RiCloud AI. It is a preferred partner of Nvidia. This status gives it priority access to the best chips. Its parent company is based in China. The chief executive of that parent company graduated from a Chinese military university. RiCloud AI signed a deal to lease three hundred servers to a company in Taiwan. That company was previously known for selling whisky. Another company called Aivres was renamed after its parent firm was blacklisted. Aivres exported billions of dollars in tech to Southeast Asia. Some of those chips went to companies providing services to Chinese firms like Alibaba. There is also a story about an affair between Nvidia's leader and a suspected asset. U.S. intelligence suspects Alice Huang might be a Chinese intelligence asset. The company she ran, Megaspeed, is under investigation for bypassing export bans. 

The new rule on remote access came into effect on November nineteenth. This date was set to stop companies from bypassing previous export controls. 

Nvidia says it expects performance to remain strong because demand for chips is very high. The United States Senate is still considering a law to give the government more control.

While technology companies face new rules, health officials are dealing with a growing crisis.

Why is a new disease outbreak in the Congo so difficult to stop? Fighting between the army and rebel groups is preventing health workers from reaching sick people.

The Democratic Republic of the Congo has faced many health crises. It is a large country in central Africa with many remote areas. Ebola is a very dangerous virus that causes severe illness. It often spreads through contact with the blood or fluids of infected people. This specific outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo species of the virus. This version is quite rare. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for this species. This makes it much harder for doctors to save lives. The outbreak began in mid-May in a province called Ituri. This region is in the northeastern part of the country. Many different armed groups have fought there for a long time. There are more than one hundred armed groups in the eastern Congo. One group is called the Convention for the Popular Revolution. It is led by Thomas Lubanga. He was previously convicted of using child soldiers in war. Even though this group promised to stop fighting, the violence has continued. This conflict makes it very dangerous for medical teams to travel. They often have to wait for peace before they can help people.

The situation became much worse as the virus spread to eight different provinces. This has turned into the second-largest Ebola outbreak ever recorded. The only larger outbreak happened in West Africa between twenty fourteen and twenty sixteen. 

New government data shows that there are now more than twelve thousand confirmed cases. At least five thousand nine hundred four people have died. These numbers might even be too low. An analysis of satellite images suggests the official death toll is underestimated. Health workers are struggling to stay safe while they work. This week, about a dozen people were trapped in a hospital for three days. This group included staff from the World Health Organization. They were caught in intense crossfire between the army and rebel fighters. They were eventually evacuated to a city called Bunia. Another worker named Sandrine Buju said her team came under gunfire. They had to hide at a United Nations base for protection. Because of this violence, health officials are missing many chains of infection. Only fifteen percent of new cases come from people who were already being watched. This means the virus is spreading quietly in many places. Strained health services and delayed testing are making the problem grow faster. 

The latest figures were released on November twenty-sixth. The report comes as the fighting in Ituri province has intensified lately. 

Responders say the epidemic is not yet under control. The next step is for the United Nations to continue escorting health teams.

As health workers face challenges in the Congo, leaders in South Korea are making big economic decisions.

Why did South Korea just raise its interest rates? The central bank wants to control rising prices while the economy is growing quickly.

South Korea is the fourth-largest economy in Asia. It is a world leader in making technology like computer chips. Recently, the country has seen a boom in exports because of artificial intelligence. This has helped the economy grow faster than expected. However, this growth also brings higher prices. The Bank of Korea is the country's central bank. Its job is to keep prices stable. To do this, it uses interest rates. When rates are higher, it is more expensive to borrow money. This helps slow down inflation. The bank wants to get inflation back down to two percent. Right now, it is around two point eight percent. 

On Thursday, the bank decided to act. It raised its benchmark interest rate to three point twenty-five percent.

This is the highest interest rate in two years. Five members of the policy board voted for the increase. Two members voted against it. The bank also raised its growth forecast for this year to three point nine percent. It expects even faster growth next year. Governor Shin Hyun-song said the technology sector is a major engine for this growth. He said profits in the chip industry could reach seven hundred trillion won. 

The decision was made during the bank's final meeting of twenty twenty-six. It follows two other rate increases earlier this year. 

Most analysts expect one more rate hike early next year. After that, the bank will likely hold rates steady to see how the economy reacts.

Next, we look at how governments and experts are gathering in Nairobi to tackle the global housing crisis.

Why are world leaders meeting in Kenya to talk about homes? They want to find ways to make housing safer and more affordable for everyone. A home is a place where people should feel safe. But billions of people around the world do not have a proper place to live. Many live in informal settlements or slums. These are areas where houses are built without official permission. These places often lack clean water or safe toilets. UN-Habitat is the agency that works on making cities more sustainable. In twenty twenty-three, it set up a special group to study this problem. This group wants to help governments create better national housing policies. This week, government officials and experts met for the third time to discuss new ideas. The meeting took place in Nairobi from November twenty-sixth to twenty-seventh. Anacláudia Rossbach is the head of UN-Habitat. She says about three hundred million people live without any roof over their heads. But there is no official global definition for homelessness yet. Having a definition would help governments include these people in their plans. UN-Habitat estimates that up to three point four billion people lack adequate housing. More than one point one billion of them live in slums. During the meeting, the agency launched a new online platform to share housing data. This platform will help countries see what solutions work in other places. Ms. Rossbach says housing is the cornerstone for adapting to a changing environment. The group wants to have final recommendations ready for a big assembly in twenty twenty-nine. The decisions made this week will help shape national housing policies for years to come.

Now we turn to a technology company in legal trouble. A federal jury in New York found the technology company Huawei guilty of several crimes. These include fraud, money laundering, and stealing trade secrets. The jury also convicted the company and its branches for breaking international trade rules. They found that Huawei violated United States sanctions on Iran. These sanctions are rules that limit trade with certain countries.

Next, we look at the latest numbers on migration in Britain. Why is the number of people moving to Britain falling so quickly? New data shows net migration dropped because the government made it much harder to get visas. For over ten years, immigration has been a major topic in British politics. Many people wanted the government to have more control over who enters the country. In twenty ten, then-Prime Minister David Cameron made a big promise. He said he would lower the numbers to the tens of thousands. He did not reach that goal. In twenty sixteen, many people voted for Britain to leave the European Union. This event is known as Brexit. People hoped it would end unrestricted travel from Europe. After Brexit, migration actually went up for a while. It reached a record high of nine hundred forty-four thousand in early twenty twenty-three. This happened as more people came for work or to study from outside Europe. There has also been a lot of focus on asylum seekers. These are people who flee their home countries to find safety. Many arrive in small boats across the English Channel. This journey is very dangerous. It has become a symbol of the struggle to control the borders. The government recently introduced strict new rules for workers and students to change this. Official data released on November twenty-sixth shows a significant drop. Annual net migration fell to seventy-seven thousand in the year ending in June. This is the lowest level since nineteen ninety-seven, if you do not count the pandemic. A year earlier, the number was two hundred four thousand. Because of this, migration dropped by about ninety percent since its peak in twenty twenty-three. Interior Minister Shabana Mahmood says the government has regained control of the system. She says the reforms make the system fairer by rewarding contribution. The new rules include a ban on many workers bringing family members with them. The government also raised the salary needed to get a work visa. This limits arrivals to people with graduate-level jobs. The number of people asking for asylum also fell by more than twenty percent. This is still higher than levels seen between twenty oh four and twenty twenty-one. However, some groups say the numbers are still too high. The populist Reform UK party says migration still puts pressure on housing and schools. They say the new figures are no cause for celebration. A recent poll by YouGov shows that immigration is a top concern for voters. It is the second most important issue after the economy. Sunder Katwala is the director of a think tank called British Future. He says the drop in migration will surprise many people. Many still believe that immigration is rising. These figures come just as the government plans to make the rules even tougher. Earlier in November, officials unveiled plans to double the wait for permanent settlement. This would change the wait from five years to ten years. While the numbers are falling, some economists warn this could hurt the economy. They say a smaller workforce could lead to less growth. Oxford Economics made a forecast in April. They said the economy could be fifteen percent smaller by twenty sixty if migration falls to zero. Lower tax revenue could also push up government borrowing. This is because there would be fewer workers to pay taxes. For now, the government is focused on what a sustainable level of immigration looks like.

The next story looks at how Amazon lost its latest attempt to stop handling more recall notices.

Why is Amazon being forced to handle more product recalls? A court ruled that Amazon is responsible for hazardous items sold by third-party companies on its platform.

Amazon runs a massive online store where other companies sell products. Many of these items are labeled as Fulfilled by Amazon. This means Amazon stores the goods and ships them to customers. For years, Amazon argued it was just a logistics provider. It claimed it was not a distributor of these goods. This distinction matters because distributors are legally responsible for safety recalls. The Consumer Product Safety Commission, or CPSC, disagreed with Amazon's argument.

In early twenty twenty-five, the CPSC ordered Amazon to recall over four hundred thousand hazardous items. Amazon sued to stop this order but lost its legal battle this week. A federal court in Maryland ruled that Amazon must act as a distributor. The hazardous products include faulty carbon monoxide detectors and hair dryers. They also include children’s sleepwear that does not meet federal safety standards. Amazon must now notify every person who bought these items. It must also give full refunds to customers who prove they destroyed the products. The company must also submit monthly progress reports for the next five years.

The ruling comes after Amazon sued the agency in March twenty twenty-five. Amazon says it is reviewing its options and will continue working with the agency.

While Amazon deals with legal rulings, a major bank is handling a security problem.

Why did a major bank’s cryptocurrency unit suffer a data leak? Standard Chartered’s crypto business had a security breach that exposed some client and employee information.

The bank Standard Chartered has a specialized unit called Zodia Custody. Like many big banks, it wants to grow in the world of digital assets. These are electronic currencies like Bitcoin. Zodia Custody keeps these assets safe for large professional investors. Just a few weeks ago, Standard Chartered bought the rest of the company to own it fully. This move showed how much the bank wants to lead in the crypto market.

On Monday, the company detected people trying to break into its computer systems. Chief executive Richard Clark told Reuters on Thursday that some data was leaked. The breach exposed the names and email addresses of some clients and staff members. When the attack was first noticed, Zodia took its connection software offline. The service has since been restored. Clark says the investigation shows there have been no unauthorized transactions. This means no money or digital assets were stolen. The company has already notified the affected clients and government regulators.

The breach was detected on Monday and the details were confirmed on Tuesday. The company’s shares rose about two point six percent on the day of the news.

As banks protect digital data, rescue teams in Indonesia are working to save lives underground.

Why is a rescue mission at an Indonesian gold mine becoming so difficult? Heavy rain flooded a deep mine shaft where dozens of people were working illegally.

Indonesia has many informal gold mines where people dig for small grains of gold. These mines are often illegal and do not follow safety rules. Thousands of people work in these dangerous conditions to make a living. They face constant risks from landslides and tunnel collapses. This mine was dug in the Bogor regency of West Java province. The shaft reached about one hundred meters deep before the accident happened. That is roughly the height of a thirty-story building.

Late Monday, heavy rain caused a nearby river to overflow into the mine. Rescuers have recovered sixteen bodies so far, and ten miners are still missing. The search team includes over three hundred twenty-five people using water pumps and ropes. Some miners managed to escape before the water filled the shaft. Local residents tried to pump the water out themselves at first. They did not tell the police right away because the mine was illegal. Authorities did not get a report until sixteen hours after the flooding started. A police spokesperson named Hendra Rochmawan said the chances of finding survivors are now very slim. Search agency chief Desiana Kartika Bahari said the team is using ropes to reach victims.

The search entered its fourth day on Thursday as teams worked through the night. The next step is for rescue teams to search two adjacent shafts for survivors.

So, to sum up today: Donald Trump’s new tariffs are expected to give India a trade advantage. The United States economy grew at a rapid four point three percent pace this summer. Amazon must now take responsibility for recalling hundreds of thousands of dangerous products. And in Indonesia, rescuers are searching for missing miners after a flood at a gold mine.

Before we go, here is your thought for the day.

Researchers have successfully used functional MRI scans to decode brain activity. They can turn a person’s inner thoughts into recognizable images. This means the internal movies of our minds are no longer hidden. By mapping how neurons fire in response to what we see, algorithms can now interpret these signals. An algorithm is a set of rules used by a computer to solve a problem. In this case, it acts like a digital translator. It converts the complex language of your subconscious into a visual file.

This technology offers a profound bridge between human cognition and external reality. Cognition is just a word for the way our brains process information and thoughts. In the future, this tool could allow us to document our dreams while we sleep. It might help non-verbal patients to share their memories with their doctors or families. We could even share complex abstract ideas directly with others without using any words. For a long time, our private thoughts were completely hidden from the outside world. This wall is now starting to dissolve. It is a major shift in how we understand the human mind. It makes you wonder: if you could record your thoughts like a movie, would you want to watch them? Would you want others to see what you are thinking?

Zodia took its connection software offline to stop the attempts. On Tuesday, the company determined that an unauthorized party had accessed some information. CEO Richard Clark told Reuters that the leak included names and email addresses. This affected a small number of clients and employees. Clark said there have been no unauthorized money transactions so far. The service has since been restored. Standard Chartered's shares in London rose about two point six percent on Thursday. The report on the breach was released on Thursday, November twenty-sixth. Zodia has already notified the affected clients and government regulators about the leak.

So, to sum up today: we looked at new trade rules for India and strong growth in the American economy. We also heard about a data breach at a major bank and a global meeting on housing. Finally, we saw how chip sellers are adapting to new trade limits.

Before we go, here is your thought for the day.

Scientists have found a way to turn brain waves into pictures. They use a special type of brain scan called an M-R-I. This scan looks at how neurons fire when you see something. Neurons are the tiny cells in your brain that send signals. An algorithm then acts like a digital translator. It takes those raw brain signals and turns them into a visual file. This means the movies playing in your mind are no longer a secret. Researchers can now see a recognizable image of what a person is thinking about. This technology could change how we understand the human mind. In the future, we might be able to record our dreams while we sleep. It could also help doctors talk to patients who cannot speak. These patients could share their memories or needs through images instead of words. It might even let us share abstract ideas directly with each other. For a long time, our private thoughts were hidden from the world. Now, that wall is starting to dissolve. It is a profound bridge between our inner thoughts and reality. It allows us to turn subconscious thoughts into something we can see. Think about what it would be like if your friends could see your imagination on a screen. Would you want to share your dreams with the world?

Thank you for listening to Sift In-Depth. We hope these stories help you feel more connected to the world around you.
